summary: While chanting, the bearer is unaffected by projectiles other than Magic Balls and their Engulfing effects; equipment can still be affected.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Only Engulfing effects from projectiles other than Magic Balls (for example Pinning Arrow).

termination.note: Must follow all Chant rules; the Enchantment ends when the Chant stops.

properties.note: Chant "Song of Deflection" or sing a song of their acrobatic prowess.

references.name: Pinning Arrow
references.note: Named as an Engulfing projectile effect that does not affect the bearer.

clarifications.text: Singing in place of the normal Chant is still a Chant and must follow all Chant rules (stopping the Chant ends the song).
The bearer's equipment can still be affected by projectiles and their Engulfing effects.

open_questions: N1 'Equipment can still be affected by the above' is read as the bearer's own equipment; the text does not say whose equipment.
